response.overview: « Playground Love » is a music video clip (short film) written and directed by Mar LACOMBA. For the well known music Playground Love by AIR. This short film was produced by Ghady El Rassy. With the participation of Florine Guenard and Iván Fejes. Shot by Viktoria Parlato Lopes De Oliveira and Talulla Binet-Ali, with Crystall Travers. This project was created as part of an introductory filmmaking workshop for second-year undergraduate film students in January 2026.
